On-Chain Operator. Module 6 · Protocol research. Navy and cyan. This is the door, not the whole module. Education only.
You can already see a bridge, an oracle, and an admin key. Research starts there. A rate comes after the mechanism.
By the end of the module you will be able to do this: complete a full due-diligence file on a real protocol. Not before. The lessons earn it one page at a time.

The lessons, in order, are 6.0 Mastery Starter, 6.1 Protocol due diligence, 6.2 Tokenomics: supply, unlocks, FDV, value capture, 6.3 Governance & DAOs, 6.4 The on-chain research workflow, 6.5 Case studies: how DeFi failures happened, 6.6 Vote-escrow tokenomics, bribes and governance markets, 6.7 Valuing DeFi protocols: fees, revenue, earnings and multiples. You do not skip ahead. Each page is the input to the next.
Lesson 6.0, Mastery Starter. Mastery Starter. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 6.1, Protocol due diligence. Run the 6-step research loop on a protocol and reach a written verdict. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 6.2, Tokenomics: supply, unlocks, FDV, value capture. Read a token's supply schedule and judge whether protocol success reaches the token. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 6.3, Governance & DAOs. Read how a protocol is controlled and spot governance risk before it hits your position. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 6.4, The on-chain research workflow. Turn research into a written thesis with invalidation and monitoring. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 6.5, Case studies: how DeFi failures happened. Learn the patterns behind major failures so you recognise them early. You will write that down when you get there.

Lesson 6.6, Vote-escrow tokenomics, bribes and governance markets. Understand vote-escrow ("ve") systems and bribe markets, a major source of DeFi yield and power. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 6.7, Valuing DeFi protocols: fees, revenue, earnings and multiples. Compare protocols on their economics, not their narratives. You will write that down when you get there.
Next is Lesson 6.0, Mastery Starter. Bring nothing but the habit: one idea, one drawing, the word Example on any number. Education only, not financial advice.
